reasoning_traces.think:
The three Ps formalize negotiation as a dynamic information-gathering and decision-making cascade. Preparation quantifies uncertainty via a checklist of verifiable data points, transforming subjective intuition into objective hypothesis testing. Probe operationalizes Bayes' rule: observing receiver reactions updates posterior distributions over their preferences, enabling conditional strategy adaptation. Propose implements optimal stopping theory—delaying commitment until information rent exceeds search cost. Together, they create a closed-loop control system that minimizes regret by systematically reducing state-space uncertainty before irreversible actions.
